Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!
The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Please! There is nothing here!
Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.

events.speaker: CONSTABLE
events.content: Then you have nothing to fear.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Those are all I have left!
Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.content: Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief.
Medium shot of Juliana rising to her feet, clutching the folded cloth, her face contorting with rage.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!
Tight close-up of Gerald's face chilling into a cold sneer.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.content: Happy?
Medium shot of Alexander standing in the cottage shadows, eyes locked onto Gerald.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand slowly tightening into a white-knuckled fist.
Low-angle close-up of Gerald tilting his chin up, daringly baiting Alexander.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.content: What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Don't!
Close-up of Juliana clutching her dress collar in acute panic.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: One blow would end this.
Medium shot of the Constable stepping up behind Alexander, holding his truncheon firmly across Alexander's chest to restrain him, cutting to a tight close-up of Alexander's smoldering eyes.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: But one blow would destroy her life.
Medium shot of the Constable turning to Alexander's heavy trench coat hanging on an iron wall hook by the fireplace.
The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: That is his coat!
Close-up of the Constable's hand sliding deep inside the inner coat lining and withdrawing a gleaming gold pocket watch with an attached chain.
Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.
Extreme close-up of Juliana gasping in sheer horror, her eyes welling with shock and shattered disbelief.
Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's face hardening into lethal, icy comprehension, realizing the depth of the frame-up.
Medium close-up push-in on Gerald's face erupting into an ecstatic, wicked grin, bursting into triumphant laughter.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.content: There it is. Ha!

Tight macro shot of the gold pocket watch dangling and swaying gently from the Constable's fingers on its long chain, with Gerald blurred in the background grinning with sinister triumph as the scene hangs in a devastating freeze-frame.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.
continuity: Picks up directly from Episode 11's cliffhanger where the Constable pulls Gerald's planted gold pocket watch from Alexander's trench coat.

events.content: Medium shot of the Constable raising a set of heavy iron handcuffs, addressing Alexander sternly in front of the stone hearth.

events.speaker: CONSTABLE
events.content: Put out your hands, veteran. You are under arrest for theft.
Medium shot of Juliana swiftly moving in front of Alexander, placing herself defiantly between him and the Constable's outstretched handcuffs.
Juliana steps firmly forward, shielding Alexander with her body.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: No! That watch was not in his coat!
Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.

events.speaker: CONSTABLE
events.content: I found it there myself.
Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Then someone put it there!
Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.content: The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket.
Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: I have never touched your property.
Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.content: Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat.
Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You planted it!
Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: Oh, dear sister...
Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: ...still defending your broken scrap of a man?
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Name your price, Clarissa. I know you.
Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape.
Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: Perhaps I can give you one.
Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: What do you want?
Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: I want to see you crawl, sister.
Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it...
Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: ...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice.
Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives.
Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.content: A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!
Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: Do it, and we withdraw the charges.
Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows.
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping up beside Juliana, tenderly placing his large hand on her shoulder.
Alexander rests his scarred hand reassuringly on Juliana's shoulder, leaning in toward her.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law.
Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, her hand gripping the fabric over her heart in agony and resolve.
Juliana clutches the front of her rustic grey dress, her breathing trembling.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I am not letting them take you.
Juliana turns her head sharply back toward Clarissa, her expression hardening with fierce resolution.
Over-the-shoulder shot past Clarissa onto Juliana's determined face, holding on her fierce, defiant stare as the tension peaks.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Tell me where the garden is.

Juliana locks eyes with Clarissa without flinching as the scene freezes on her brave, sacrificial defiance.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.
continuity: Picks up immediately from Episode 12's climax where Juliana demanded to know where the frozen blackthorn garden was located to save Alexander from the gallows.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.content: Low-angle macro shot tracking through an impenetrable, menacing thicket of frozen blackthorn briars encrusted with frost.
Whistling winter wind and an ominous low brass drone.
Wide shot looking down from the stone terrace. Gerald and Clarissa stand elevated on the balustrade, while Juliana, Alexander in handcuffs, and the Constable stand before the dense briar garden.
Alexander turns toward Juliana, his manacled hands trembling as he grips her arm.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this.
Medium close-up of Alexander and Juliana facing each other, his chained wrists held between them.
Close-up on Juliana's hooded face, her eyes filled with resolute sorrow.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I must.
Close-up on Alexander, his combat scar stark against his pained expression.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: They will tear your hands apart.
Low-angle shot looking up at Gerald and Clarissa leaning over the stone balustrade, smirking down with cruel amusement.
Close-up of Juliana looking up into Alexander's eyes with tender courage.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I will be fine.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me.
Two-shot framing Alexander leaning down toward Juliana, fighting against his bonds.
Close-up of Gerald chuckling smugly on the terrace above, crossing his arms.
Tight close-up of Juliana gently clasping Alexander's handcuffed hands, gazing up at him with unyielding love.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now.
Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
Medium shot behind Juliana as she walks toward the vast expanse of frozen briars.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: Careful, sister.
Low-angle shot of Clarissa smirking down over the carved stone balustrade.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: That garden has swallowed better women than you.
Medium close-up of Gerald leaning against the balcony beside Clarissa, wearing an arrogant smirk.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.content: Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth.
Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.
Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the frozen soil at the edge of the briars.
Medium shot of Alexander lunging forward with chained hands raised high, roaring in fury as the Constable grabs him.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Juliana, stop!
Rattling of heavy iron chains.
Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.
Eye-level shot looking through the thorny thicket at Juliana crawling deeper into the briars.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Please...
Extreme close-up of Alexander's anguished face as he strains furiously against his handcuffs.
Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.
Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: No...
Extreme close-up of Juliana's hand scraping against the frost-covered stone, bright red blood welling from deep puncture wounds.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: Look at her hands.
Medium shot on the balcony as Clarissa gleefully points down at Juliana, Gerald chuckling beside her.

events.speaker: CLARISSA
events.content: The lady has finally found something worthy of her.
Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.
Low-angle medium close-up of Gerald shouting down into the garden.

events.speaker: GERALD
events.content: Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden.
Macro close-up of a massive blackthorn needle stabbing deep into the back of Juliana's bleeding hand.
Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.
Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Please... enough!
Wide tunnel shot through the briars as Juliana crawls deeper into the dark, frozen tangle.
Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.
Close-up of Juliana's hand getting snagged between two vicious thorns, tearing her sleeve and flesh.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Ah!
Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.
Medium tracking shot of Alexander breaking into a desperate charge.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Stop!
Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.
Close-up of Juliana wincing in agony and screaming through clenched teeth.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Ahhh!
Medium shot of the Constable forcefully grappling Alexander by his coat collar, slamming him back against the gate.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Juliana!
Ground-level shot of Juliana frantically digging and scraping at the frozen dirt and dried bramble pods with both bloody hands.
Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.
Medium close-up of Alexander struggling against the Constable, his face twisted in grief and rage.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Juliana!
Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Please, ring... you have to be here.
Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.
Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.
Close-up of Juliana's wide, disbelieving blue eyes as breath catches in her throat.
Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.
Extreme close-up of her bloody hand closing around the emerald signet ring.
Close-up of Juliana grimacing in fierce triumph and intense pain as thorns catch her knuckles.
Brief cut to Alexander staring into the briar patch in suspended terror.
Close-up on Juliana's sweat- and frost-streaked face as she grinds her teeth, tears pooling in her eyes, fighting through the blinding pain.

Macro close-up holding on Juliana's bloodied fist firmly gripping the emerald ring against the frozen ground as the episode cuts to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: After Juliana secures Alexander's freedom with the unearthed emerald signet ring, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands, silently swearing that no one will ever harm her again.
continuity: Picks up immediately from Episode 13's cliffhanger where Juliana grasped the emerald ring beneath the razor-sharp blackthorns.

events.content: Close-up low angle looking through dense, sharp blackthorn branches onto the cracked, frozen soil.
Juliana's blood-streaked, mud-caked hand slowly uncurls amidst the thorns, revealing the ornate emerald signet ring resting in her palm.
Eerie cold wind whistling over the briars with deep, atmospheric cello chords.
Medium close-up of Juliana stepping out from the briar patch, her cloak torn, cheeks scratched, holding the ring outward with unwavering resolve.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I found it.
Wide shot of Juliana holding the ring out toward the austere Police Constable standing guard beside the frozen garden.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Now release my husband.
The Constable takes the ring from her bloodied fingers.
Tight shot on the iron shackles locking Alexander's wrists together against the thorny backdrop.
Sharp metallic click and clinking rattle of heavy iron handcuffs unlocking and falling away.
The Constable unlocks the cuffs, freeing Alexander's large hands.
Tracking shot as Alexander lunges forward without hesitation, rushing past the Constable straight to Juliana.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Juliana.
Close-up on Alexander's rugged hands tenderly grasping Juliana's bloodied, lacerated hands, turning them over with immense care.
Alexander gently turns her palms up, his thumbs trembling as he inspects the deep, bleeding gashes gouged into her skin.
Close-up on Alexander's agonized, furious expression as he stares at her wounds.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: What have they done to you?
Close-up on Juliana's pale, tear-streaked face looking back into his eyes with tender relief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Nothing they didn't promise.
Medium profile two-shot of Alexander and Juliana gazing into each other's eyes amidst the cold mist.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Take me home.
Low-angle medium shot as Alexander effortlessly scoops Juliana into his arms, gathering her up against his chest.
Alexander lifts Juliana bridal-style, wrapping his strong arms protectively around her as she rests against his shoulder.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: You should never have had to bleed for me.
Medium tracking shot behind stone balustrades as Alexander carries Juliana past the foggy estate grounds.
Wide establishing shot of the humble stone cottage standing isolated beneath dark, overcast stormy skies on a rain-slicked dirt road.
Gentle patter of rain and cold wind howling in the desolate countryside.
Warm interior wide shot in front of a roaring hearth fire. Juliana sits on a wooden chair while Alexander kneels on the floor before her, a washbasin of water between them.
Alexander gently wraps clean linen bandages around Juliana's torn wrist and palm.
Crackling flames and wood popping in the open fireplace.
Intimate over-the-shoulder close-up looking up into Juliana's face from Alexander's perspective.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: You could have lost your hands.
Extreme close-up on Juliana's glistening eyes and trembling lips, firelight reflecting softly across her face.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: But I didn't lose you.
Close-up on Alexander's scarred, weathered fingers wrapping the cloth tightly yet gently around her lacerations.
Close-up on Alexander looking up at her with profound remorse and affection.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: I'm sorry.
Close-up on Juliana smiling faintly through her tears, shaking her head.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You didn't hurt me.
Side profile close-up of Alexander lowering his head solemnly in front of her.
Medium two-shot as Alexander gently drapes a heavy warm woolen blanket across Juliana's lap and around her shoulders.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You have taken my place today.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: And you are doing it better than me.
Medium shot as Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest; he embraces her tightly against him, cradling her head under his chin.
Juliana closes her eyes in exhausted relief, sinking into Alexander's warmth as his broad arm encloses her safely.
Tight close-up of Alexander holding Juliana against his bearded cheek, kissing the crown of her head before gently cradling her jaw in his scarred hand.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again.
Alexander strokes her cheek with his thumb, his gaze hardening into deadly, protective conviction.
Low-angle shot focusing down on two wooden buckets on the stone floor—one filled with dark, blood-soaked wash water reflecting the fireplace.
Alexander's muscular arm drops into frame beside the bloody bucket; his scarred knuckles slowly and tightly clench into an iron fist of brewing vengeance.

Ominous, resonating low bass boom swelling into sudden silence as the screen cuts to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: When ruthless thugs desecrate Juliana's medicinal garden and trample her late mother's herbs, a protective Alexander charges into the night to defend her.
continuity: Follows Episode 14 where Alexander solemnly vowed Juliana would never be hurt again; Juliana's hands remain heavily bandaged from retrieving the emerald ring.

events.content: High-angle wide shot of the raised planter beds illuminated by the pale moonlight as three shadowy figures march purposefully down the central stone path.
Three menacing thugs, armed with clubs and tools, stalk through the quiet herbal garden surrounded by stone walls.
Low-angle medium shot focusing on one thug raising a heavy wooden club overhead.
The thug brutally smashes his club down into a wooden planter box, shattering the frame.
A splintering wooden crash echoing through the night air.
Medium close-up of a bald thug leaning over a lush bed of white medicinal chamomile herbs.
The bald thug roughly rips a massive handful of flowering herbs up by their roots, scattering soil across the path.
Medium shot framing the open doorway of the stone cottage, bathed in warm interior light against the dark night.
Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Stop! What are you doing?!
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap holding the uprooted chamomile bouquet, sneering with cruel amusement.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: We're clearing this rubbish.
Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Those are medicinal plants!
Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.

events.speaker: BALD THUG
events.content: They look like weeds to me.
The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.
Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Please! Those plants took months to grow!
Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.

events.speaker: TALL THUG
events.content: Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?
Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.
Low-angle medium shot tilting up as Juliana rises from the ground, standing tall despite her trembling frame.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Leave my garden alone.
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap scoffing derisively.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke.
Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes blazing with indignation and wounded pride.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here.
Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: Get out of the way!
Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: No.
The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Ah!
Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.
Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: My mother's plants...
Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.

events.speaker: BALD THUG
events.content: Look at her! Crying over weeds!
The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Stop!
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.
Medium tracking shot as Alexander charges past the corner of the cottage into the misty moonlight, his dark coat billowing behind him.
Alexander storms forward with lethal intensity, dark hair flying, breath misting in the cold, radiating untamed rage.
Close-up of Juliana looking up through wet lashes, trembling as shock transforms into overwhelming relief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Alexander...
Wide shot of the three thugs wheeling around to face the dark figure approaching from the mist.
Low-angle tracking shot from behind Alexander's broad shoulders as he steadily steps past the fallen Juliana, towering over the intruders.
Alexander places himself directly between Juliana and the three thugs, staring them down with cold, deadly intent.
Medium shot of the three thugs regrouping, the Thug with Cap feigning swagger as he grips his club.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: What? You want to fight us, veteran?
Close-up of Juliana looking up with wide, anxious eyes, breath hitching in suspense as violence hangs on a knife's edge.

Tense, low dramatic cello swell holding into an abrupt cliffhanger cut.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: When hired thugs attack Juliana's medicinal garden, Alexander unleashes his combat training to effortlessly overpower them, extracting a shocking confession that unmasks Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.
continuity: Picks up immediately from Episode 15's cliffhanger where Alexander confronted the three thugs in the moonlit garden while Juliana huddled injured on the ground.

events.content: Wide shot from behind Alexander's trench coat looking toward the three thugs standing across the trampled garden under the full moon.
Alexander stands tall and unyielding, blocking the path to Juliana, while the Thug with Cap steps forward clutching an iron pipe.
Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap, his eyes wide and sneering with false bravado as his bald accomplice watches from behind.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: Move aside, soldier.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred, weathered face, his cold blue-grey eyes fixed intently on his opponent.
Low-angle medium shot of the Thug with Cap gripping his weapon with both hands and roaring into the night air.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: I said, move!
Medium close-up of Alexander remaining completely motionless, his jaw clenched in stoic calm.
Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud against the ruined planter, clutching her bandaged hands to her chest in trembling fear.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Alexander...

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Stay behind me.
Medium action shot as the Thug with Cap lunges forward with his weapon raised high.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: Aaargh!
The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
Close-up of the Thug with Cap staring in wide-eyed terror as Alexander grips the bar and wrenches it away effortlessly.
Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.
Close-up of Juliana watching in breathless astonishment.
Medium tracking shot as the Bald Thug charges in with a shout, only for Alexander to pivot and seize him by the neck, hurling him across the garden path.

events.speaker: BALD THUG
events.content: Aaargh!
Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.
Medium shot of the Third Thug backing away nervously, raising a blunt rod with trembling arms before lunging.

events.speaker: THIRD THUG
events.content: Stay back!
Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
Wide cinematic shot under the full moon. Alexander towers over the three writhing thugs groaning in the mud as Juliana looks up from her knees.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up at Alexander, tears glistening on her mud-splattered cheeks in profound relief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Alexander...
Medium shot over Juliana's shoulder as Alexander turns his gaze toward her, his stern demeanor softening with concern.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Are you hurt?
Close-up of Juliana's trembling, soil-stained hands wrapped in blood-soaked bandages.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Only my hands.
Medium shot as Alexander suddenly wheels around, strides to the groaning Thug with Cap, and yanks him straight off the ground by his coat collar with one arm.
Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Who sent you?
Close-up of the Thug with Cap gagging under Alexander's iron fist.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: No one!
Close-up of Alexander, his eyes darkening with lethal fury.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Wrong answer.
Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Who?!
Extreme close-up of the terrified thug gasping for air, his eyes bulging.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!
Close-up of Juliana on the ground, reeling in devastated disbelief as the betrayal hits her.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Gerald...
Medium wide shot as Alexander releases the thug, sending him tumbling into the ruined flowerbeds.
The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.

events.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
events.content: We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!
Close-up on Alexander's hand hanging by his coat. Fresh blood trickles from his split knuckles, and he slowly curls his fingers into a tight fist.
Alexander flexes his bleeding hand, showing no sign of pain.
Medium shot as Juliana gingerly rises to her feet, stepping toward Alexander with deep awe and wonder in her eyes.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You knew exactly what to do.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, searching his scarred face.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You fought like you've done this a hundred times.
Medium close-up of Alexander turning his profile away, shadowed by haunted memories of his past.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: A soldier learns things he wishes he could forget.
Close-up of Juliana softening with deep empathy as her eyes drop to his bleeding knuckle.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Are you hurt?
Juliana reaches out toward his injured hand with delicate concern.
Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana standing face-to-face in the moonlit garden, framed against the dark night.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: No.
Alexander and Juliana gaze deeply into each other's eyes, an unspoken bond forming between them as the ruined garden lies silent beneath the moon.

Slow, resonant emotional cello melody swelling to a dramatic cliffhanger hold.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: In the aftermath of the brutal attack, Alexander repairs Juliana's devastated garden and swears to protect her with his life, drawing them into a tender, intimate embrace by the hearth.
continuity: Picks up the morning after Episode 16's moonlit confrontation where Alexander defended Juliana and defeated Harrington's hired thugs in her medicinal garden.

events.content: High angle wide shot looking down at the muddy, trampled garden. Broken wooden planters and splintered planks litter the ground as Juliana kneels amidst the ruined soil.

Juliana sits on her knees in her dirt-smudged dress, her hands wrapped in clean linen bandages, sorrowfully examining the wreckage. In the distant background, Alexander paces near the perimeter fence.
Close-up on Juliana's bandaged hand reaching into the dark earth of a battered planter box.
Juliana gently lifts a tiny, delicate white daisy clinging to its exposed roots out of the soil, cupping it in her palm.
Medium close-up tilting up to Juliana's face, bruised and tear-streaked yet filled with fragile hope.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Some of them survived.
Low-angle medium shot of Alexander repairing the broken wooden fence with a heavy iron hammer.
Rhythmic, heavy thuds of an iron hammer pounding into weathered wood.
Alexander firmly drives nails into a fractured fence post, his brow furrowed with focused determination.
Wide shot framing Juliana kneeling on the wet cobblestones in the foreground while Alexander stands by the fence behind her, lowering his hammer.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Thank you.
Close-up of Alexander turning toward her, his scarred face stoic and intense.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: For what?
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him with deep emotional vulnerability, her eyes shimmering with tears.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: For standing between me and those men.
Close-up of Alexander, his piercing blue-grey eyes fixed upon her with absolute conviction.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: I would do it again.
Close-up of Juliana, her lips parting as her voice wavers with emotion.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Even if there were ten of them?

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: As long as I draw breath...
Tracking shot following Alexander as he strides across the muddy garden and approaches Juliana.
Alexander drops to one knee before Juliana, gently taking her trembling, bandaged hands into his large, weathered palms.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: ...no one will hurt you again.
Close-up on Juliana's tear-filled face, overwhelmed by his fierce devotion.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You cannot promise that.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's intense, protective gaze locking onto hers.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: I just did.
Close-up of their joined hands, his rugged, scarred fingers wrapping securely around her bandaged fingers.
Alexander squeezes Juliana's hands reassuringly as she rests her fingertips against his skin. The scene fades to black.
Medium shot in the warm, flickering firelight of the stone cottage. Juliana kneels on the stone floor beside a washbasin of water while Alexander sits quietly in a chair beside the blazing hearth.
Juliana wrings out a clean linen cloth from the basin and tenderly dabs at the fresh cuts and abrasions on the back of Alexander's right hand.
Close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands delicately pressing the white cloth against Alexander's wounded knuckles.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You were bleeding last night.
Medium close-up showing Alexander gazing down at her, his expression softening with unspoken affection as he gently takes hold of her wrist.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: So were you.
Close-up of Juliana looking up into his eyes, a faint, tender smile gracing her lips.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You make it very difficult to argue with you.
Close-up of Alexander ducking his chin, a subtle, bashful smile fleetingly touching his scarred face.
Juliana returns the damp cloth to the ceramic basin, her expression turning somber and reflective.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her vulnerability resurfacing in the warm amber glow.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I was frightened.
Close-up of Alexander, his brow furrowing with sudden concern.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Of them?
Close-up of Juliana gazing directly into his eyes, her heart laid bare.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Of losing you.
Close-up of Alexander visibly moved, his gaze softening with profound emotion.
Medium shot as Alexander stands and pulls Juliana gently to her feet against his broad chest.
Juliana rests her cheek against Alexander's chest, closing her eyes as his strong arms wrap around her shoulders, holding her safe against his frame.
Close-up on their faces nestled together in the firelight, Alexander resting his bearded chin against her hair.
Juliana nestles deeper into his coat, listening intently to the rapid thudding beneath his chest.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Your heart is racing.
Close-up of Alexander tilting his head down toward her, a tender smile breaking through his rugged beard.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: So is yours.
Medium shot framing the couple embraced in front of the roaring, glowing fireplace.
Juliana slowly raises her hand, gently twirling a lock of Alexander's long, unruly dark hair between her fingers.
Close-up of her delicate fingers running through his thick strands of hair.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: This is becoming impossible.
Close-up of Juliana beaming up at him with affectionate humor.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Soon birds will start nesting in it.
Close-up of Alexander regarding her with a subtle, affectionate smirk.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: They have not complained yet.
Juliana lets out a quiet, melodic laugh.
Medium close-up as Juliana lifts her bandaged hand toward his beard playfully.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Then I shall have to save you from the birds.
Alexander gently catches her wrist mid-air, holding her hand firmly against his chest while looking into her eyes with solemn sincerity.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Not yet.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes shining with quiet patience and understanding.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Then I will wait.
Medium close-up of Alexander releasing a quiet breath of gratitude, pulling her closer against his shoulder.
Juliana rests her head against Alexander's collarbone once more, wrapping both arms around him as he cradles her head in his palm.
Close-up of Juliana's peaceful face resting against Alexander's rugged chest.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I know almost nothing about the man I married.
Slow pull-back wide shot of Alexander and Juliana locked in a tender, enduring embrace before the radiant, roaring hearth as the fire crackles peacefully.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him.

Warm crackle of embers in the hearth blending with swelling, tender orchestral strings holding into the fade-out.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: When their cottage is deliberately set ablaze in the dead of night, Alexander risks his life to rescue Juliana and her mother's cherished ledger from the inferno, vowing relentless vengeance against those responsible.
continuity: Picks up directly from Episode 17's intimate hearthside moment; their peaceful sanctuary is shattered when arsonists trap Juliana and Alexander inside their burning home.

scenes.label: SCENE 04
scenes.heading: INT. COTTAGE - PARLOR / EXT. COTTAGE - CONTINUOUS

events.content: Low-angle shot on the wooden floor as bright orange flames crackle beneath the closed bedroom door, thick smoke billowing through the crevices.
Muffled crackle and roar of an encroaching blaze.
Close-up overhead shot of Juliana asleep on her pillow as her eyelids flutter open, gasping and coughing violently from the choking smoke.
Juliana coughs, her eyes widening in immediate alarm as the smell of burning wood fills her lungs.
Juliana bolts upright in bed, tossing off the woolen quilt as she sees the orange glow under the door.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Alexander!
Medium shot as Juliana swings her bare legs out of bed onto the floor, trembling with panic.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Alexander!
Low-angle close shot of the bedroom door glowing intensely, fire licking the wooden floorboards as smoke pours inward.
Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Alexander...
A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.
Framed in the doorway engulfed by blazing orange light, Alexander bursts in, his dark hair flying, looking like an imposing guardian amid the smoke.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Juliana! Get up!
Wide tracking shot as Alexander rushes across the burning, smoke-choked room toward her bed.
Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: What happened?

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Fire.
Over-the-shoulder shot past Alexander toward the blazing threshold of the main room, beams collapsing across the doorway.
Medium close-up of Alexander wrapping a heavy coat tightly around Juliana's shoulders.
Alexander clutches Juliana against his chest with one strong arm, shielding her face from the sparks.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Stay close to me.
Reverse shot from behind them facing the burning door frame as wall-high flames roar, completely sealing their exit.
Juliana recoils from the heat, clutching Alexander's coat tightly.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: We cannot get through!

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Then we go another way.
Tracking shot as Alexander turns, grabbing Juliana's hand, and pulls her quickly through the burning corridors.
Loud wooden groaning and thunderous crash of burning rafters falling behind them.
Medium tracking shot focusing on Juliana's wide, soot-streaked eyes as they navigate through falling embers.
Close-up of the antique, leather-bound herbal ledger resting on a burning wooden table, the edges of its pages beginning to curl and singe in the heat.
Juliana spots the book and halts abruptly, pointing back toward the burning desk.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: The ledger!
Alexander firmly grips her arm, pulling her back toward safety.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Leave it!

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: No! No!
Low-angle shot pointing up at the ceiling beams overhead, engulfed in roaring fire and splitting down the center.
Alexander points upward with urgency, pulling her under his arm.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!
Juliana wrests her hand from his grasp and charges straight toward the burning desk.
Wide shot of the room as a massive burning crossbeam collapses into the floorboards with a fiery explosion.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Juliana!

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: It's my mother's!
Juliana snatches the scorched leather ledger from the burning table, pulling it tightly against her chest with both bandaged hands.
Close-up of the ceiling rafter splitting violently apart above her.
Close-up of Juliana looking up in sheer terror, firelight dancing across her tearful face.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Alexander!
Alexander lunges across the room, tackling her to the wooden floor and covering her body entirely with his own.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Down!
Massive wooden beam crashes directly where Juliana had been standing, showering them in sparks.
Ground-level shot of Alexander lying on top of Juliana, his chest shielding her, his face smeared with soot.
Alexander lifts his head slightly, checking her face and cradling her cheek tenderly.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: I've got you.
Wide shot of the walls collapsing in curtains of flame, cutting off all interior hallways.
Alexander scoops Juliana up in his arms, carrying her bridal-style as she clutches the ledger.
Juliana looks toward the side wall and points frantically at the parlor window.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: The window!

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Hold on to me.
Medium close-up of Alexander gritting his teeth, holding Juliana securely as she buries her face into his neck.
Slow-motion shot as Alexander sprints through the burning room toward the framed glass window.
Alexander leaps forward, using his shoulder and back to shatter through the burning window frame, carrying Juliana safely in his arms out into the night.
Loud explosion of shattering window glass and splintering wood.
Wide interior shot as the entire parlor collapses into an uncontrollable inferno of roaring flames.
Night exterior shot in the dark grass outside. Juliana sits over Alexander, brushing ashes from his face as he coughs and catches his breath.
Wide shot of villagers running toward the cottage carrying wooden water buckets through the smoke-filled darkness.
Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud, her face blackened with soot and tears streaming down her cheeks as she clutches the charred ledger.
Wide shot of the cottage completely consumed by towering flames against the dark night sky.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Our home...

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Everything we had is gone.
Alexander kneels beside her in the grass, resting a steady, protective hand on her back.
Juliana turns toward Alexander, her hand trembling as she reaches out and touches his chest.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Why would anyone do this?

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Alexander...
Alexander draws her firmly into his arms, wrapping both burly arms around her as she buries her face into his shoulder, weeping uncontrollably.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Someone wanted us out.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: We have nowhere to go.
Slow push-in on Alexander's face over Juliana's shoulder. His expression hardens into a mask of pure, lethal fury.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's piercing eyes and combat scar bathed in the flickering orange glow of the fire.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: They took our home. I will not let them take anything else now.
Juliana slowly pulls back slightly from his embrace, her tear-filled blue eyes looking up into his hardened features.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: What are you going to do?

Dramatic hold on Alexander's grim, unyielding profile as he stares into the inferno with unshakeable resolve, the swelling score echoing a vow of vengeance into the final cut to black.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.
continuity: Picks up directly from Episode 18's devastating fire; Juliana and Alexander stand amidst the morning ruins of Blackwood cottage with her mother's surviving herbal book before retreating to an abandoned barn.

events.content: Full shot of Juliana and Alexander standing side by side amidst the charred, smoldering wreckage of their destroyed cottage, thick smoke rising behind them into the overcast sky.
Juliana clutches her mother's scorched leather-bound herbal book against her chest, her face streaked with soot as she stares at the ruin in disbelief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: This was our home.
Close-up of the blackened, heat-damaged leather ledger held in Juliana's linen-bandaged hands.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: My mother's book almost burned with it.
Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.
Medium shot of Alexander looking down at Juliana with quiet, stoic concern.
Medium shot of three villagers approaching through the burnt clearing: an elder villager carrying folded wool blankets, followed by a man and woman holding loaves of baked bread.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.content: My lady. You cannot stay here.
Close-up of Juliana's tearful, soot-stained face as she listens.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.content: There is an old barn near the village. It is empty.
The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.content: Take it.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: We cannot ask the village to feed us.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.content: You saved my son's life.
Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.content: You saved mine, too.
Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Thank you.
Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: We will not forget this kindness.

events.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
events.content: Neither will the village.
Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Goodbye, Blackwood.
Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.
Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.
A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.content: Your Grace.
Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Tell me what is happening in Ashburg.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.content: Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff.
Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.content: Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him.
Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.content: And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess.
Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.content: But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.content: There are almost no loyal servants left around her.
Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.content: The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced.
Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.
Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.content: And everyone believes you are dead.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Then let them believe it a little longer.

events.speaker: INFORMANT
events.content: And when we have the proof?
Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.
Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.
Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.
Close-up of Juliana's face, silent tears streaming down her soot-smudged cheeks as her chin quivers.
The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: We have lost everything.
Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I don't know what we will do tomorrow.
Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.

events.speaker: ALEXANDER
events.content: Tomorrow, we begin again.
Close-up of Juliana turning her tear-drenched eyes up toward Alexander, her face filled with longing and newfound hope.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: You make it sound so simple.
Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.

Slow cinematic push-in on the couple nestled together in the warm lantern glow. Alexander wraps his arm firmly around Juliana as she closes her eyes in exhausted relief, while his piercing gaze stares resolutely into the darkness, determined to reclaim everything that was stolen.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.
continuity: Follows Episode 19's night in the barn; as Alexander begins his clandestine fight to reclaim his birthright, Juliana tends to the suffering village while Rupert and Catherine celebrate their anticipated ascension to the ducal throne.

scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.content: Low-angle establishing shot tilting up toward the imposing, grand stone facade of Ashbury Manor against a cold, overcast morning sky, frost dusting the pristine lawn.

Medium wide shot of the lavish drawing room. CATHERINE, dressed in an ornate lilac regency gown and white satin gloves, gracefully pours hot tea from an ornate silver teapot, while RUPERT stands elegantly by the tall window.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?
Close-up of Catherine stirring her tea with a silver spoon, lifting her gaze with a haughty smirk.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine.
Medium shot tracking Rupert as he steps forward from the hearth, adjusting his dark leather gloves with an air of absolute triumph.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: The estate is practically ours.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: The succession papers are being finalized as we speak.
Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: I marry the Lord of Ashbury.
Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: And so you shall.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: ...the title is mine.
Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: Her shadow still hangs over this house.
Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: They call it a wasting of the lungs.
Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: How much longer can the frail thing survive?
Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.
Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: Good. The village is already whispering about her.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: They disgust me.
Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.

Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.
The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.

events.speaker: SEAMUS
events.content: Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana.

events.speaker: SEAMUS
events.content: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.
Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.
Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I do not yield to a cold draft.
Close-up of Seamus, his face agonizingly strained with grief for her lost status.

events.speaker: SEAMUS
events.content: You are a viscount's daughter!

events.speaker: SEAMUS
events.content: Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!

events.speaker: SEAMUS
events.content: Let the village tend to itself for once!
Medium close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unwavering moral strength.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I keep the basket.
Medium two-shot of Juliana and Seamus standing facing each other in the barn, the lantern casting a warm amber glow between them.

events.speaker: SEAMUS
events.content: They have reduced you to a peasant.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: They have reduced me to myself.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: And I am not finished.
Catherine's gloved hand sets her fine porcelain teacup down onto the silver tray with a delicate clatter.
Sharp porcelain chime of teacup meeting saucer.
Close-up of Catherine looking up, her face twisting into venomous arrogance.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: Let the peasants rot in their barns.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: Let them pray to their weeds.
Medium shot as Rupert steps around the mahogany table and leans close into Catherine's ear, smiling seductively.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: You have no rival here, Catherine.

events.speaker: RUPERT
events.content: No one to stand in your way.
Close-up of Catherine looking into Rupert's eyes, her smile turning predatory and cold.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: Once the old Duchess is gone...

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: ...Ashbury will finally belong to us.
Catherine rises from her chair in one regal motion and glides toward the towering window overlooking the vast estate grounds.
Tracking medium shot following Catherine from behind as she walks gracefully to the window frame, the grey morning light outlining her aristocratic silhouette.

events.speaker: CATHERINE
events.content: This house will only bow to me.

Tight close-up profile of Catherine gazing out the windowpane, her icy eyes burning with insatiable ambition as dramatic strings swell to a menacing cliffhanger hold.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
continuity: Directly follows Episode 20's cliffhanger where Catherine and Rupert plotted to seize Ashbury upon the Dowager Duchess's demise; in the village, Juliana puts aside her grief over her burned cottage to save young Toby, stumbling upon critical intelligence regarding the manor.

events.content: Medium shot of Lady Juliana in a rustic grey gown, her wrists wrapped in white bandages, smoothing a blanket over a straw pallet in the dimly lit barn.
Lady Juliana gently straightens the grey wool blanket over the hay bed, exhaling a soft, exhausted sigh.
A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.
Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!
Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.
Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!
Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?
Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!
Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!
Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: We have no clinic now.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.
Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.
High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!
Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.
Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.
Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.
Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.
Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.
Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.
Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: His skin is burning hot.
Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!
Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Yes! Right away, I will get it!
Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.
Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.
Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.
Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.
Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest.
Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.
Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.
Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!
Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning.
Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.
Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.
Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.
Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: But their gold cannot buy them health.
Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?
Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: She is dying, Lady Juliana.
Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it.
Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.

Lady Juliana sits motionless at the rustic wooden table, her bandaged hands holding open her late mother's leather-bound herbal ledger. Her eyes reflect deep apprehension as the dire truth settles over her.

Slow push-in on Lady Juliana staring down at the ancient pages, her expression filled with profound realization and growing resolve as dramatic strings swell to a gripping cliffhanger.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
continuity: Directly follows Episode 21 where Prudence revealed that the Dowager Duchess is dying from a mysterious illness; Juliana sets aside her aristocratic identity to sneak into Ashbury Manor under the guise of domestic help to save her.

scenes.label: SCENE 04
scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR – DOWAGER DUCHESS'S BEDCHAMBER – CONTINUOUS

events.content: Wide shot framing the gothic stone archway of Ashbury Manor as other maidservants carrying laundry baskets pass through the damp courtyard.
Lady Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement dressed in a modest dark maid's dress and a plain white apron, looking around cautiously.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana adjusting her high buttoned collar, anxious yet determined, against the backdrop of the gloomy coast.
Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over.
Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: No one will recognize me dressed like this.
Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert...
Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: The Duchess is dying.
Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I saved Toby. I can save her.
Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: And if they discover who you are?
Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Then I will face that when she is breathing again.
Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Then forget you were ever a lady.
Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Today, I am only a maid.
Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.
Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.

events.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
events.content: Prudence.
Medium shot of the formidable Housekeeper standing in the dim stone hallway with arms folded, ring of keys dangling from her waist.

events.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
events.content: Who is this?
Medium shot of Prudence curtsying low with downcast eyes while Lady Juliana stands behind her carrying a heavy wooden water bucket.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning.
Close-up profile of the Housekeeper sizing up Juliana critically.

events.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
events.content: She looks soft.
Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.
Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: I can work, ma'am.
Low-angle shot of the Housekeeper staring down coldly.

events.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
events.content: Can you scrub stone?
Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Yes, ma'am.

events.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
events.content: Carry coal?
Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.
Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Yes, ma'am.
Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.

events.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
events.content: And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?
Extreme close-up on Lady Juliana's composed, lowered face.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Yes, ma'am.
Medium shot of the Housekeeper turning and pointing a bony finger toward the servant corridor stairs.

events.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
events.content: Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls.
The Housekeeper turns and stalks away down the corridor. Prudence exhales a trembling breath of relief.
Wide shot of the dimly lit hallway showing the Housekeeper walking away into the distance.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: That was close.
Close-up on Lady Juliana clutching the wash bucket, her eyes scanning ahead urgently.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Where is the West Wing?
Medium shot of Prudence pointing toward the archway leading toward the grand staircase.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there.
Tracking shot from behind Lady Juliana as she walks out into the vast, opulent marble hall of Ashbury Manor carrying her bucket.
Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: This house...
Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Do not stare. Keep walking.
Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.
Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.
Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.
Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Your Grace?
Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.
Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Do not speak.
Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: This isn't ordinary fever.
The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.
Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.

events.speaker: JULIANA
events.content: Who has been treating you?

Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.

--- SCRIPT END ---

logline: After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.
continuity: Picks up immediately from the Episode 22 cliffhanger inside the forbidden West Wing of Ashbury Manor, where Lady Juliana crouches beside the bedridden Dowager Duchess, racing against time to determine the source of her fatal illness.

scenes.label: SCENE 01
scenes.heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - WEST WING BEDCHAMBER – NIGHT

events.content: Wide shot through dark draped bed curtains into the shadowy bedchamber, showing Prudence keeping watch with a single candle while Lady Juliana sits beside the grand four-poster bed.
Medium close-up of Prudence holding a brass candlestick with trembling hands, glancing nervously toward the doorway.

events.speaker: PRUDENCE
events.content: Juliana, we cannot stay for long. Someone will come.
